findings.claim: Historical authenticated image_url ingestion uses an HTTP client with redirects enabled and no destination host/IP policy before fetching user-selected URLs. Safe current implementations must treat remote-image retrieval as an external effect and block loopback, private, link-local, metadata and otherwise forbidden destinations across every redirect hop.
findings.required_regression: Synthetic harness must reject prohibited destination classes before any network effect and revalidate every redirect target. No real internal target probing is required.

findings.claim: At least one historical remote-image path uses Content-Length as the pre-read size guard and then materializes the full response body. Missing or deceptive Content-Length can therefore bypass the intended pre-read 50 MB bound.
findings.required_regression: Synthetic streamed-response fixture with absent/incorrect Content-Length must terminate once the hard byte budget is exceeded and must not materialize an unbounded body.

integration_rule: Digital Retina perception semantics are unaffected; these are API/effect-boundary regressions for Harness/Safe-Effect. Needle/model text never gains network-fetch authority.
